name: codex-auto-pilot
description: Deliver approved plans through a minimal-context PR stage and optionally auto-start a fresh release task.

interface.shortDescription: Build a verified PR and optionally auto-start its fresh release task
interface.longDescription: Uses one canonical Sol PR controller, at most one fresh Terra implementation session, one compact handoff, and an optional one-command ship lane that starts a separate Sol release task after PR readiness.
defaultPrompt: $auto-pilot pr <approved-plan-path>. Use ship instead when I explicitly want Auto Pilot to create a fresh release task immediately after the PR becomes ready.
